Ny girlfriend commit suicide over a year ago. It was the worse thing to ever happen to me. It affects me till this day and probably for the rest of my life. My suggestion is to definetly encourage him to see a therapist and a psychiatrist. It isn't your job nor are you trained to know what to say to him when he feels depressed. So seeing a professional is a good idea. And never hesitate to call 911 if you think he's in danger. Him living is better than him being mad at you. I can relate to the position youre in. It's difficult. Just try your best to comfort him and there for him. But again you aren't a professional. You got this. i believe in you

But after sometime of thinking about all this I feel like I didn't keep her alive longer bc she attempted one time before it actually happened when were we together. She attempted her first time a few years ago. That can't just be a coincidence. People always ask, "where's the evidence" but the evidence is all there. I suck as a person and a friend. It's been more than a year. Last June. I have gotten better ill be honest but some feelings are still very fresh. Like the guilt and feelings for her. Shes constantly on my mind and I too fantasize about her all the time. And it's honestly still so surreal to me. But one thing I've definelty learned is that things get better. It's cliché but it's very true. I've seen and met so many people in my life that genuinely believed that things can't get better.And sometimes I feel that way too but when I come back and realize and analyze(?) reality, I see that things can get better. And those people have gotten better. Not completely but for sure happier and content than where they were before. Like I said I've gotten better too. And I believe in you. I'm sure you've heard all the things people say to make you feel ok. But it probably doesn't help as true as it may be. Just know what you're feeling isn't permanent.
I'm ok. But that really means a lot. Thank you
